about.title: About CodeLava
about.heroImageAlt: CodeLava key art: code brackets around a glowing volcano
about.storyBody: CodeLava brings product thinking, design and engineering into one team. We work closely with founders and business owners, ask the questions that shape the right solution, and explain every important decision in plain language — in Arabic or English.
about.mission: To give ambitious businesses software they can rely on: clear in scope, honest in delivery and built to keep working long after launch.
about.vision: To be the engineering partner companies across the region turn to first when an idea needs to become a dependable product.
about.valuesLead: The habits that keep projects clear, predictable and easy to own after we hand them over.

clarity.title: Clarity before code
clarity.body: We map real workflows, edge cases and trade-offs before writing production code, so scope stays honest and predictable.

bilingual.title: Bilingual by architecture
bilingual.body: Arabic and English are engineered in from day one — true RTL layouts, careful typography and content that reads naturally in both.

ai.title: Applied AI with guardrails
ai.body: We use AI where results can be measured on real examples, with human review wherever judgement matters.

handover.title: Built to hand over
handover.body: Maintainable code, documented infrastructure and clear release steps, so your team can run the system with confidence.

about.marketsLead: We partner with businesses across the Gulf and Egypt and with international teams, building products that feel local in language and detail.
